ref: verifier agent prompt, section Native kernel support policy
what: The policy offers a tensor-manipulation-op wrapper (ttnn.to_layout / tilize / untilize) as the sanctioned [~] partial-tick escape hatch for layout refinements, but the run prompt mandates exactly one native dispatch per call, which forbids any wrapper. A verifier following the agent prompt literally would file a queue entry naming an escape hatch that invalidates the run.
suggest: In the Native kernel support policy, state that when the run imposes the one-dispatch rule the wrapper fallback is unavailable and a partial ships an in-kernel subset (e.g. tile-aligned RM first) with a lettered follow-up.
